## Approximations (declared)

- draw sets are scrambled-Sobol prior draws conditioned on the calibrations (feasible only), reweighted per synthetic set (sec. 12.2's 'by reweighting'); a density whose PSIS k-hat >= 0.7 or ESS < 100 reads 'not resolved' (a tie); results ignoring that rule are reported beside
- tie bands from 40 measurement-noise redraws per unit and set (the prereg's 4 000 for scoring)
- censored U3 values: product of conditional marginals (exact for one); adequacy leaves them out
- Holm's guard step is not simulated: power is optimistic on that account
- synthetic sets are generated from the truth's primary-form predictions and scored under each form
- a rival with no feasible draw under a form (its calibration infeasible there) has lppd -inf: the other side is read as favoured under that form without its adequacy test (flagged by_infeasibility; optimistic)
